activity_summary: At the lodging door, home from the Theatre, you said you would not cut her and you would not write her a line lower. Six weeks is the time you named. You did not turn it into a date. You told the boy to hold. You were not in a street.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Spoke the refusal to no one at the door, and held the boy in the same breath.

facets.activity: Told the boy to hold at the lodging door

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: I'll not cut her. I'll not write her a line lower.
